title: New Product Launch Video and Photos | AIVideosUGC
description: Create product launch videos and photos from one product image: make a teaser, reveal, and listing asset before launch day, without a studio booking or reshoot.
h1: Create Your Product Launch Video and Photos Fast
lead: Paste a product link and get a product launch video and photos: a script, an actor, and a voice that tightens the wait, before the date is public.

faq.q: How many credits does a launch photo or video use?
faq.a: A photo uses 24 credits. Video uses 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, or 120 for 30. You see the cost before the job starts, and a failed job returns those credits.

faq.q: Can I change the timer on the launch video?
faq.a: Yes. Set the end time in the built-in editor and move it if the day slips. You decide when the countdown stops.

faq.q: Will anyone else see my unreleased product?
faq.a: No. The upload and the result stay in your account, and they are not published until you share them.

faq.q: What frame should a launch visual use?
faq.a: A product photo is square. For video, use 9:16 for Stories, Reels, and TikTok, 1:1 for a feed, 16:9 for a wide page, or 4:3 and 3:4 when the placement needs them. Each video is its own job.

faq.q: How long can the launch clip be?
faq.a: Clips run 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Six seconds fits a quick reveal. Use 15 or 30 seconds when the launch needs a fuller product story.

faq.q: Can the countdown use an actor from the library?
faq.a: Yes. Pick one, describe the look and the outfit, or build one from a short clip of you. That presenter is generated, not a real customer or a celebrity.

faq.q: Can I bring my own product clip into the countdown?
faq.a: Yes. Upload the footage or the photo you already have. It can sit in the countdown next to the actor, the script, and the timer.

faq.q: Can I make launch videos for many products at once?
faq.a: Yes. Batch mode runs a set of product links and returns one countdown each. Review every file before it is published.

faq.q: Can my store request launch videos through an API?
faq.a: Yes. The API lets your store ask for a countdown from a product link. The file stays in your account until you share it.

faq.q: Can I add a voiceover, music, and captions?
faq.a: Yes. Choose an AI voice, set the pace, pick a track from the music library, and turn on automatic captions. The same script can be spoken in another language.

faq.q: Can I publish the teaser to TikTok or Meta?
faq.a: Yes. Publish in one click to TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, or Meta, or download the file. The download has no AIVideosUGC watermark. Platform ad rules still apply.

faq.q: Can I change the launch date after the video is made?
faq.a: Yes. Move the timer or the date line in the editor, so a new day does not mean a new scene.
